name: Dayline
subtitle: Personal daily dashboard — tasks, bookmarks, everything synced.
description: Dayline is a personal daily dashboard: to-dos with sections, tags and reminders, a bookmark library with rich previews, all synced in real time across Mac and iPhone.

apps.name: Dayline
apps.subtitle: Your day, on every device — to-dos, bookmarks, reminders, self-hosted sync.
apps.localizedDescription:
Dayline is a personal daily dashboard for iPhone and Mac.

TO-DO — tasks in named sections with a Pinned section on top, quick-add focused on launch, drag or menu to move tasks between sections, colour tags shared with the Mac, and reminders that fire as notifications with Mark Complete / Dismiss actions.

BOOKMARKS — a library of links and notes with rich previews, comments and tags, searchable, and fed by a Safari share extension that saves from any app.

SYNC — every change goes to your own sync server (a small Cloudflare Worker) and fans out live to every device over a WebSocket. Works offline and reconciles when back online. No iCloud, no third-party services, no analytics.

Install tip: choose "Keep App Extensions (Use Main Profile)" in SideStore so the share extension can use the app's credentials.

versions.localizedDescription:
Calmer log, and a fix
• Category tiles in the Expenses log are now one neutral grey — a column of rows reads as one list instead of a stack of colour chips. Categories keep their colours in Settings
• Fixed: editing an expense's time across "now" (for example 10:12 AM → 10:12 PM today) saved correctly but the row kept showing the old time until the app was reopened

Instant sharing again
• Links shared from Safari (or any app) go straight to your sync server again — they appear on your Mac within a second, even when Dayline is closed
• Works with FlareStore: the app now shares its sign-in with the share sheet (open Dayline once after updating)
• Offline shares are still kept and added the next time you open Dayline — without duplicates

Ready for FlareStore
• This source now works in FlareStore (and still in SideStore, AltStore, ESign, Feather and Scarlet)
• The expiry warning follows your certificate: 3 days before it runs out you'll be reminded to renew it in FlareStore
• Includes everything from 1.10.9 — better battery life with the same instant sync

Better battery life, same instant sync
• The app no longer reconnects to sync every time Wi-Fi signal quality changes, and pulling down Control Center no longer reconnects either
• Nothing runs in the background any more; the connection closes when you leave the app and catches up instantly when you return
• Saves happen only when something actually changed, and the keychain is read once instead of on every reconnect
• Fixed: a second edit to the same item while the first was still uploading could be lost
• The empty-Expenses + animation no longer uses CPU (and stops while covered)
• Failing site icons, link previews and dead tweets are no longer re-downloaded over and over
• Sync speed is unchanged or slightly faster

One look across every tab
• Expenses and the add-expense screen now share the navy background of To-Do and Bookmarks
• The top-right settings gear is now a ••• menu button

Full task text, Mac tag colours, new total font
• To-Do › gear › "Show full task text": wrap long tasks onto several lines, or keep them to one
• Task tag colours now match the Mac exactly — all 16 colours, same shades
• The Expenses total uses Sora, in a lighter weight
• "Share extension status…" removed from the To-Do menu

Your category order, everywhere
• Categories appear in the order you set — on iPhone and Mac alike
• Reorder them on the Mac (Settings › Expenses, drag the handle) and the iPhone follows
• Renaming a category never moves it

Cleaner To-Do cards
• Each group's tasks sit in a softly recessed panel under the title
• No more lines between tasks — tighter rows, more on screen
• Tags are now rounded rectangles, same as the Mac
• Emoji group icons show on their own, no background tile
• The expense + is gone from the To-Do header (add expenses from the Expenses tab)

Note suggestions while you type
• Typing a note on the expense screen shows your past notes that match
• Tap one to fill the note — amount, category and wallet stay as they are
• Best matches first: notes that start with what you typed, then recent ones

A clearer To-Do, and a bolder total
• To-Do grouped as Pinned · Today · Categories · Done Today
• Your emoji are the section icons, same as the Mac
• A small + on each section opens an input row; Return adds, ✕ closes
• Rounded-square checkboxes with a fill-and-tick animation; checked rows settle, then glide below
• Finished sections get a green check and fold into Done Today
• No "Completed" toast
• Expenses: centred period menu, bold SF total, "Total Spent" under it

Smoother Expenses log
• Vertical drags on entries always scroll; swipe-to-delete only on a sideways drag
• Total, period chip and search/filter pinned at the top
• This Year folds earlier months into one row each (count + total); tap to expand
• Chip reads This Month ⌄ / This Year ⌄ / Last Month ⌄
• Faster list; no total jump after a swipe-delete

A calmer empty Bookmarks page
• No empty card: a light bookmark glyph and two centred lines — "Links you save will appear here. Share from any app, or tap + to add one."

Category and wallet on every row
• Each expense's second line reads time · Category · Wallet; upcoming entries lead with the date

Amount stays centred
• The entry screen's amount is pinned to the exact middle; the EXPENSES label and note hang off it

Entry screen label
• The small EXPENSES label now sits above the amount, in capitals

Delete key on the keypad
• ⌫ in the keypad's bottom-left trims whatever you edited last (amount or note); hold to clear
• Category pop-up's top button reads "＋ Add Category"

Payment method up front
• Entry screen's top row shows your payment methods as pills — tap to choose, tap again to clear; last used is preselected
• Small "Expenses" label under the note

Expenses first
• Tabs are now Expenses · To-Do · Bookmarks, and Dayline opens on Expenses

Quieter upcoming expenses
• Upcoming entries use a subtle grey tile with no outline; the category colour appears once the date arrives

Expenses, redesigned
• Ledger log: total large in the middle, compact day sections, no card — more entries on screen
• Search and category filter at the top; period chip for this month / last month / this year
• One big + in the middle of the bottom bar
• New entry screen: big amount, note pill, calendar date pill, category pop-up (Edit at top), full keypad, wallet in the top-right
• Swipe to delete works again, with Undo
• Blue + at the top of To-Do to log an expense
• Expenses tab icon fixed
• No more false expiry warning on SideStore installs

Tabs, quick add, lighter entry
• All three tab names visible (To-Do · Bookmarks · Expenses)
• This month's total on the Expenses add button — a soft white pill with ＋
• Second floating button on To-Do to log an expense without switching tabs
• Entry screen shows your top 4 categories, with a More chip that expands the row in place

Expenses entry polish
• Note is a real, always-visible field under the amount, with suggestions from past notes
• Time is one dropdown (Now · 1h ago · This morning · Yesterday · Custom…) that shows the resolved time
• Categories are one scrollable row of icon + name chips, most-used first, with ＋ New at the end
• ✓ sits on the keypad and lights up when amount + category are set
• Log: total leads, month and entry count under it, period as a dropdown; taller rows with the category in the secondary line

Expenses — a new tab for logging what you spend
• Three taps to log: amount on the keypad, tap a category, done — your four most-used categories sit above the keypad and the last wallet is preselected
• Whole amounts only, no decimal point
• Time as chips: Now · 1h ago · This morning · Yesterday, plus a compact picker for anything else
• Custom expense types: add your own categories (emoji, name, colour); they sync everywhere
• History by day with totals, and a This month · Last month · This year switch
• Swipe to delete with a 4-second Undo; search by note, category or exact amount
• New "New Transaction" action in the Shortcuts app and Siri — logs without opening the app
• Syncs live with the Mac; readable by nr-finance

Compatibility update — prepares for Expenses
• The sync engine now tolerates record kinds it doesn't know: an unknown record no longer fails the whole sync batch and leaves the app "offline"; it is cached and shown once the app is updated
• Install on every device before the Expenses feature arrives
• No other visible changes

Share extension: instant, never doubles, takes comments
• Saves are instant — the extension no longer downloads the whole sync change log to store one link; it sends the app's current sync position and gets a handful of rows back
• No more duplicates — Save locks on first tap (spinner + Saving…) and each share builds exactly one sync record, so a second tap or a retry can't create two bookmarks
• New Comment box — a note added in the share sheet lands in the bookmark's comment field
• Cleaner sheet — the page behind is dimmed instead of blacked out; Save is now the large full-width button
• Opens faster — the App Group check is cached per signed build and memory-mapped instead of re-reading the app binary every time
• The app keeps its sync position in the keychain for the extension (refreshed on background and after each sync)

Share extension works under SideStore
• Captures upload directly to your sync server when no App Group is available — the same record the app emits, so the Mac and every device receive it through normal sync
• Three-tier save: App Group queue → direct upload → dayline:// deep link, with a plain error if none can run
• The app mirrors its sync server address into the keychain for the extension

App Group discovery from the signed binary
• The extension reads the App Group from the entitlements embedded in the signed executable (own + host) plus team-ID rename patterns, each verified with the OS
• Share extension status lists every candidate with ✓/✗
• Superseded by 1.8.8 — diagnostics proved SideStore grants no App Group at all on a free Apple ID

OS-verified App Group probing + diagnostics
• App Group candidates probed from both the extension's and the app's signed profiles and confirmed with the OS before use
• New: Gear menu → Share extension status… shows which container each side resolved and when the extension last ran

Runtime App Group resolution
• The App Group ID is read from the embedded provisioning profile at runtime instead of being hard-coded, so re-signers that rename groups don't break Safari captures

First SideStore release
• To-Do tab first, with quick-add focused in the Pinned section on launch
• Move tasks between sections by drag or from the task menu; ordering syncs
• Task tags with two-way sync to the Mac; reminders with notification actions
• Section header bands with progress; collapsed state persists
• Sync status in the gear menu; keyboard-aware bottom bar
• Sync engine tuned for low CPU and memory
